mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (id,user_id,template_id,template_title_snapshot,simulation_json,created_at) VALUES (#{id},#{userId},#{templateId},#{templateTitle},CAST(#{simulationJson} AS JSON),#{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tasks WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT FROM tasks WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT stage,status,started_at,finished_at,error_message FROM task_steps WHERE task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY stage_order
SELECT asset_id FROM task_assets WHERE task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY position
SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE status='QUEUED' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM tasks WHERE status='RUNNING' ORDER BY created_at,id
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET status='RUNNING',started_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='QUEUED' AND current_stage IS NULL

UPDATE tasks SET current_stage=#{stage},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
AND current_stage IS NULL AND current_stage=#{previous}
UPDATE task_steps SET status='RUNNING',started_at=#{now} WHERE task_id=#{id} AND stage=#{stage} AND stage_order=#{order} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE task_steps SET status='SUCCEEDED',finished_at=#{now} WHERE task_id=#{id} AND stage=#{stage} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE tasks SET version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND current_stage=#{stage}
UPDATE tasks SET status='SUCCEEDED',result_asset_id=#{resultAssetId},finished_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND current_stage='FINALIZE' AND result_asset_id IS NULL
UPDATE task_steps SET status='FAILED',finished_at=#{now},error_message=#{message} WHERE task_id=#{id} AND stage=#{stage} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE task_steps SET status='SKIPPED' WHERE task_id=#{id} AND stage_order > #{order} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE tasks SET status='FAILED',current_stage=#{stage},failed_stage=#{stage}, error_code='PROCESS_INTERRUPTED',error_message=#{message},finished_at=#{now}, started_at=COALESCE(started_at,#{now}),version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
